summary.en: Three pages tumble edge-on into a stair, are pulled into one point that flashes, and a single smoke ring grows around the slammed title.
summary.zh: 三张页卡从侧棱翻飞成阶梯，被吸进一点闪白，一圈烟环从中长出，片名砸进环心。

fits: The last poster of a launch film: the product's pages gathered and spent into its name (outro, climax).
notFor: Middle sections (it ends everything on screen); titles longer than one word; quiet, editorial films (the flash and the ring are loud).

intent.en: The film's peak of energy collapses into its name: the product's pages are gathered and spent in one flash, and the title slams through a ring of smoke.
intent.zh: 全片能量顶点收缩成产品名：几张页面被一把吸走、一闪而尽，片名穿过烟环砸出来。

content.en: Three page painters (optional, the sample's otherwise), a one-word title (≤ 10 chars, Chinese ≤ 4 characters), an optional eyebrow, tagline (≤ 40 chars, Chinese ≤ 10) and a wall phrase.
content.zh: 三张页面（可选，不给就用样例）、一个单词片名（≤ 10 字符、中文 ≤ 4 字），可选眉题、标语（≤ 40 字符、中文 ≤ 10 字）和背景字墙短语。

fits.zh: 发布片的最后一张海报：产品的几张页面聚拢、耗尽，变成它的名字（落版、高潮）。

notFor.zh: 中段（它把画面上的一切收掉）；长于一个词的片名；安静的编辑风片子（闪白和烟环很响）。

en: Use it once, at the film's energy peak; it ends everything on screen.
The smoke ring is the aftermath of the collapse, not a celebration: no confetti or particles on top.
zh: 只在全片能量顶点用一次；它会收掉画面上的一切。
烟环是坍缩的余波，不是庆祝：别再加礼花或粒子。

upstream.name: 卡片翻飞收束
upstream.summary: 三张 UI 页卡从侧棱薄边 3D 翻飞成阶梯站定（全程清晰、样条连续丝滑），站定后保持慢转不停，快速收束吸入中心，炸出单个湍流烟雾环扩散，巨字横贯收场
upstream.use: 能量高潮段（功能页群→品牌口号的爆点转场）；霓虹/极光暗场调性；"多页面能力"收束成一句话的段落

overlaps.note: collapse-burst shrinks a word into a dot and bursts it into particles that become the next word; flock-finale pulls three cards into a point and grows one smoke ring around a slammed title
converge-mark gathers pieces into a mark; flock-finale's pull lasts ten frames and its point flashes and rings instead of forming a mark
